name: linkedin-agent
description: Fifteen Claude skills: eleven that run a LinkedIn account (posts off 21 hook formulas, comments, replies, profile score, weekly plan, DMs, inbox triage, carousels, repurposing, audits, and a humanizer that strips the AI fingerprint) and four for the job hunt (ATS diagnosis, keyword demand across real postings, X-Y-Z bullet rewrites without invented numbers, mock interviews).
